title: Independent-universe completed module localization sequence
statement: Fix $\ell,E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Z$ be qcqs schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], $i:Z\to X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], and $V$ a pro-etale object over $X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] whose structural map is a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism] with image the complement of $i(Z)$. Let $a$ be the localizedSystemAdjunction for the completed commutative coefficient sheaf at $V$ [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. For each completed-coefficient module $M$, $a.\mathrm{counit}_M$ is monic, the actual ordinaryAdjunction unit for $i$ is epic [def-fix-qcqs-completion-ordinary-models], and their composable pair is exact [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. Module universe $\max(u,t+1)$ permits independent scheme and coefficient-field universes.

proof.text: Refine each affine object by a bounded w-contractible extension. Cut out the closed support by the ideal spanned by finitely many elements, using quasi-compactness of the complementary open. Cover by their distinguished opens and the closed localization. The latter has the ring-retraction property, hence evaluation of epimorphisms of Type(max(u,t+1))-sheaves is surjective, and all its points specialize into the closed fibre.

On an open piece, the subterminal slice object makes Over.forget full. The adjoint-triple criterion and the triangle identity make the extension counit bijective on its sections. The closed pullback is empty and its module sections are zero. On a specialization piece, refine local representatives of sheafification; every lift to V has empty source, so the extension sections vanish. The actual closed unit is bijective by the completed specialization-unit lemma.

The resulting section sequences are injective, surjective and image-kernel exact. Sheaf separatedness descends injectivity and the zero composite; local lifts give an epimorphism. Apply the same lifting argument to the kernel lift to obtain categorical exactness. All scalar actions and the actual units and counits were retained.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryCompletedLocalizationSequence
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Z : Scheme.{t}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [CompactSpace Z] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Z]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (V : X.ProEt) [IsOpenImmersion V.hom] [QuasiCompact V.hom]
    (hV : Set.range V.hom = (Set.range i)ᶜ) :
    let a := SheafOfModules.localizedSystemAdjunction.{t + 1, t, u}
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X) V
    ∀ M : Mod l E X none,
      Mono (a.counit.app M) ∧ Epi ((ordinaryAdjunction l E i).unit.app M) ∧
      (ComposableArrows.mk₂ (a.counit.app M)
        ((ordinaryAdjunction l E i).unit.app M)).Exact
